notes.title: Update 2nd August 2019
notes.content: With this update we further improved on some game play issues

notes.title: Update 11th March 2019
notes.content:
In this update we have:-
Improved some issues for game-play
Added more music tracks
Fixed some errors in the translations
Plus we have fixed other minor issues

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]Latest Update is now available.[/h1]
[list]
[*] French, Italian, German and Spanish translations added.
Select your language from the main menu.

[*] Lighting Changes to improve the overall look of the fighters

[*] The following new moves have been added.

	Body hook left & right
	3 Kick punch combos only used by fighters with kicking skills
	Cross to body right
	Hit on body response
	Jab to body
	Low kick to inner thigh
	Spinning back kick to body

[*] AI changes.

	Improved balance and directional movement.
	AI on hit responses has been extended, so there is better response on more moves.
	Kicking range has been adjusted to stop kicks happening so close to the opponent.
	Stepping forward has been increased for boxers based on their boxing grade, so they can get closer to the opponent to throw a punch.• Lighting Changes to improve the overall look of the fighters
[/list]

notes.title: Update 19th December
notes.content:
Today's update corrects a few minor issues, and we have also:- 
•	increased the possible revenue from ticket sales (by increasing attendance)
•	plus added TV income for semi finals and final of Cup and Shield
